title: Claim
description: A sourced assertion about an account-state field. Competing claims coexist; the reducer selects one winner per field by standing, then recency, then confidence. Outranked claims are retained.

opportunity_id.description: Scope (ADR-0016). A uuid scopes the claim to that deal: it folds into that opportunity's state and competes only with claims of the same deal. Null scopes it to the account. Person-scoped paths (buying_group.member, delegation) are about a person and fold account-wide whatever this says.

subject_person_id.description: Person the claim is about (e.g. champion, stakeholder role).

value.description: Field value; the string 'unknown' is legal.

extractor.description: 'rule:<name>@<ver>' for deterministic Go rules, 'llm:<model>@<prompt ver>' for AI, 'human:<surface>' for approvals.

allOf.description: A first-party record is a deterministic fact from our own systems (ADR-0009), so it must come from a rule.
ADR-0012: an org_change names its kind and a summary; subject_person_id is whose role, remit or ownership changed (null for an account-wide change).

ADR-0012: expansion needs and business value are stated in the customer's words (a non-empty text), or withdrawn: {stance: 'withdrawn', text} records 'the rollout is off' so a retraction is read as one and the old need no longer counts.

fieldPath.description: AccountState field a claim folds into. 'commitment' folds into current_commitments, 'buying_group.member' / 'stakeholder_role' / 'delegation' fold into buying_group; 'org_change', 'expansion_need' and 'business_value' (ADR-0012) fold into the list fields org_changes, expansion_needs and business_value; every other value folds into the field of the same name. These are the paths a model may extract from text (claim_candidate.v1.json).

fieldPathPendingExtraction.description: Field paths in the contract that the extractor does not emit yet (extract-v5, WP3 / HAR-101 follow-up). Until then production cannot satisfy the transition facts that read them (ADR-0012).

stance.description: Absent means stated. 'withdrawn' records that the change was called off.

claimFieldPath.description: Every path a stored claim may carry: the extractable fieldPath values plus 'amount', which only the CRM rule emits (a number, folds into OpportunityState.fields.amount, ADR-0016). A model never proposes it.
